Pharma Near You

Find the pharmacies around you — and which of them are open right now.

When you need a pharmacy you usually need it quickly, often at night, and often somewhere you do not know. Pharma Near You answers that in one screen: the nearest pharmacies, sorted by distance, each marked open or closed against its real opening hours, with a route one tap away.

Open right now

Calculated from each pharmacy's own opening hours, with 24-hour ones highlighted.

Works offline

Your country's data is downloaded once and kept on the phone. No signal needed after that.

Forty-four countries

Pharmacies across Europe, from Portugal to Ukraine. English, Turkish and Bulgarian.

Your medicine shelf

Keep your medicines, doses and notes. All of it stays on your phone.

No account, no server

There is nothing to sign up for and nothing of yours on anyone's server. Your notes, medicines and profile never leave your phone, and your location is used on the device to sort pharmacies by distance — it is not sent anywhere, because there is nowhere to send it.

Where the data comes from

Pharmacy locations and opening hours come from OpenStreetMap, maintained by its volunteers, and are rebuilt daily. This site is also where the app fetches them from: one compressed file per country, served as static files, which is the whole of the app's backend.

Opening hours are as accurate as the map data behind them. If it is urgent, especially at night, please call ahead.
